title: HS50023: Economics Of Cpr Management
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: HS30072Course ContentsIntroduction to Common Property Regime:
Definition, Scope and the Context; Common Property Resources versus Private,
State and Open Access Resources; Access to CPR and Livelihood Strategies in
India; Status and Extent of CPR and its Management in India; Problems of
Commons: Tragedy of Commons; Theories of CPR Management: Collective Action and
Participation, Game Theory and CPR Management; Agency Theory and CPR
Management; The Evolutionary Model; Institutions and CPR Management:
Decentralisation and Devolution of CPR Management, Evolution of Co-Management
System; Ostroms Eight Principles of Self-Governing Institutions; Analysis of
Failure and Success of CPR Management: Water, Forests, Grazing Lands,
Biodiversity, Irrigation.
